newsitem.title: NAMIBIA: NAMIBIAN STOCKS WEEK- Strike fears hit Gold Fields.
newsitem.headline: NAMIBIAN STOCKS WEEK- Strike fears hit Gold Fields.

text.p: Gold Fields Namibia was in the spotlight on the Namibian Stock Exchange last week with a strike at its Tsumeb Corp unit slashing some 30 percent off its market capitalisation.
Gold Fields Namibia opened the week at N$2.50, traded up to N$2.60, but fell to N$1.80 by Wednesday where it stayed.

Elsewhere, interest focused on financials with Standard Bank seeing a N$13 million deal on Thursday with some 76 million shares trading at N$172.00. Metropolitan Life and Mutual & Federal saw trade worth N$3.1 million and N$2.4 million respectively.
Total turnover in the week was N$23.4 million with 614,959 shares changing hands. The NSE Overall Index fell to 226.92 from 228.93 while the Local Index finished at 155.84 from 157.54.
